Embedded output cannot land in a package the injected packages depend
on: the generated imports would form a cycle.
-- go.mod --
module app

go 1.27

require github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli v0.1.0

replace github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli => CLIDIR
-- fabrik.yaml --
generate:
  emit: embedded
  dir: appwire
-- appwire/host.go --
package appwire

type Host struct{}
-- shared/db.go --
package shared

import "app/appwire"

type DB struct{}

var _ appwire.Host

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() (*DB, error) { return &DB{}, nil }
-- shared/cli.go --
package shared

import "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"

//fabrik:cli:command
func Sync(ctx cli.Context, db *DB) error { return nil }
-- want/diags --
error: fabrik.yaml:2:9: generated code imports app/shared, which imports the output package app/appwire
  help: point generate.dir at a package the injected packages do not depend on
